title: Bat dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='16' ry='18' fill='#6A3FA0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#8B5FC6'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='13' fill='#6A3FA0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='10' fill='#8B5FC6'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <polygon points='39,28 34,10 44,22' fill='#6A3FA0'/>
  <polygon points='61,28 66,10 56,22' fill='#6A3FA0'/>
  <polygon points='40,26 36,14 44,22' fill='#D48BE8'/>
  <polygon points='60,26 64,14 56,22' fill='#D48BE8'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='35' r='2.5' fill='#2EE6D6'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='35' r='2.5' fill='#2EE6D6'/>
  <circle cx='45.8' cy='34.2' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='55.8' cy='34.2' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M46 41 Q50 45 54 41' stroke='#2EE6D6' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Tiny fangs -->
  <polygon points='47,41 47.8,43 48.6,41' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <polygon points='51.4,41 52.2,43 53,41' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Left wing (raised, dancing) -->
  <path d='M34 50 Q18 30 8 38 Q14 42 12 50 Q18 48 20 54 Q24 50 28 58 Q30 52 34 50Z' fill='#6A3FA0'/>
  <path d='M32 50 Q20 34 12 40 Q16 43 15 50 Q20 48 22 53 Q25 50 28 56 Z' fill='#8B5FC6'/>
  <path d='M30 48 Q22 38 16 42' stroke='#4A2A70' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M26 48 Q20 42 16 46' stroke='#4A2A70' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Right wing (lowered) -->
  <path d='M66 50 Q82 64 92 56 Q86 52 88 46 Q82 48 80 42 Q76 46 72 38 Q70 46 66 50Z' fill='#6A3FA0'/>
  <path d='M68 50 Q80 60 88 54 Q84 51 85 46 Q80 47 78 43 Q75 46 72 40 Z' fill='#8B5FC6'/>
  <path d='M70 52 Q78 58 84 54' stroke='#4A2A70' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M74 52 Q80 56 84 52' stroke='#4A2A70' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <path d='M44 74 L41 86 L37 86' stroke='#6A3FA0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 74 L59 82 L63 82' stroke='#6A3FA0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='87' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#D48BE8'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='83' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#D48BE8'/>
  <!-- Belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='8' ry='10' fill='#A87FD4' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Dance sparkles -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#FFE66D'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='32' r='1.5' fill='#FFE66D'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='60' r='1.5' fill='#FFE66D'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='70' r='1.5' fill='#FFE66D'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='80' r='1.5' fill='#FFE66D'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='20' r='1.5' fill='#FFE66D'/>
</svg>
